# SEVEN3SEVEN

> Hybrid fitness and performance brand producing structured strength, endurance and conditioning programmes built to be followed, not filed away.

SEVEN3SEVEN is founded by Nico, a former British Army soldier and All Arms Physical Training Instructor. Every programme combines an interactive web app (session-by-session tracking, timers, logging, progress and personal bests) with a permanent downloadable PDF.

Each programme costs £19.99 GBP as a one-off payment with lifetime access. SEVEN3SEVEN is an independent brand and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or partnered with the British Army, ATHX, HYROX or Hybrid Games.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview and current programmes.
- [About](/about): The story behind SEVEN3SEVEN and its founder.
- [Programmes](/programmes): Full catalogue of hybrid training programmes.
- [Basic Training Blueprint+](/programmes/basic-training-blueprint-plus): 12-week British Army assessment and Basic Training preparation programme — mid-thigh pull, medicine-ball throw, 2 km run and military work capacity. £19.99.
- [S.E.M 2026](/programmes/sem-2026): 8-week hybrid competition programme built around strength, endurance and MetCon for ATHX-style athletes. £19.99.
- [S.E.M 2027](/programmes/sem-2027): 12-week hybrid competition programme built around progressive strength, engine development and event-specific conditioning. £19.99.
- [Hybrid Race Plan](/programmes/hybrid-race-plan): 12-week hybrid race programme for HYROX-style and Hybrid Games-style events. £19.99.
- [Apparel](/apparel): SEVEN3SEVEN apparel.
